title: Ship navigator · Level 3: Five buoys
brief: Square your back on the harbour wall and set the heading to 0 (north). Five buoys stand on the chart, measured from the start dot (where the middle of the axle sits after squaring): buoy 1 800 mm north, 300 mm east; buoy 2 1600 N, 0 E; buoy 3 1500 N, 1200 E; buoy 4 700 N, 1600 E; buoy 5 1300 N, 2200 E. Reach them in any order: a buoy is reached when the middle of the robot's axle is inside its green circle. 10 for each buoy; up to 40 for speed, only when all five are reached, timed when the fifth is reached (par 35 s); 10 for touching no buoy and no wall but the harbour's. The run ends at the fifth buoy, when the program ends, or at 60 s. Pass: a mean of 60, and 4 of 5 runs reach three buoys or more.

score.run: round(10 * visited + if(visited == 5, 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)), 0) + if(touchesOf_buoy1 + touchesOf_buoy2 + touchesOf_buoy3 + touchesOf_buoy4 + touchesOf_buoy5 + touchesOf_wallW + touchesOf_wallE + touchesOf_wallN == 0, 10, 0), 1)
